items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I knew he had two or three brothers, one of them Evans Mosby; you know him, don't you?

ctx.x: Mr. Curtis Mosby was very well known for his wheeling dealings in the area. I think he was the brother of Red Mack, who was--Mrs. Hightower taught Red Mack and Curtis Mosby was his brother.
I didn't know that. I knew he had two or three brothers, one of them Evans Mosby; you know him, don't you?

I've heard of him. Maybe we'll come back to that later, because their mother--the mother of Red Mack was a very well know real estate person during that time. He had nightclubs in the area, as I've been told, and also had his financial difficulties,which you are reiterating now.
